query: I bought my phone with the limited-edition neon blue popsocket bundle last year, and now I can’t make or receive any calls at all — I already noticed airplane mode is turned on, my line was suspended for an overdue bill right as my contract ended, my SIM card is locked with a PIN I can’t remember right now, and I think the SIM card might be unseated. Can you help me fix this?
